correctness.rationale: The explicit Cayley map has positive real part, fixing the branch. The two boundary moduli and norm-one exposing functional are exact. The odd Fourier moment establishes that the exposing functional is independent of the first N-1 Taylor functionals, hence exact codimension N. Boundary equality and Hardy uniqueness prove the singleton minimum-lift set. Weak-star compactness permits minimal norm lifts; extreme quotient geometry follows from the exposing functional, and finite-dimensionality converts extreme into strongly extreme. All N>=1, 0<c<1 are covered by the argument.

value.rationale: This resolves a specifically posed 2026 yes/no characterization negatively under its stated unrestricted weak-star closed hypothesis. It constructs counterexamples for every finite quotient dimension and every 0<c<1, making the non-inner minimizing representative arbitrarily far in sup norm from all inner functions; this identifies a material missing structural assumption for any repaired conjecture. It is a natural problem-specific obstruction, not a numerically tiny improvement or an arbitrary parameter slice. The proof is elementary, but the answer changes the scope of the proposed criterion.
